name: Momo Palmyra Falstaff
original_name: モモ・パルミラ・ファルスタッフ
source:
Momo is a middle-class humanoid spirit who has a contract with [url=/c116623]Dan Saliel[/url]. She is not suitable for conflicts of any kind, including having no fighting skills. Her best ability is housework, as a result she is forced by her contractor to always wear a maid outfit and often gets bullied by him. Despite this, she still admires Saliel very much. Momo relieves her sadness from the bullying by tending to her pet goldfish, Tama.
